column1: # Panel node "server" strings for the ws-path protocol aliases (/anytls, /hy2, /naive).
# Read by two implementations of the same rule, which must not drift:
#            SingR-docker.sh SYNC BLOCK, which picks the inbound type at `singr add`)
# Columns, TAB separated (the server string is last and may contain spaces):
#   go     NodeType ParseV2rayNodeResponse returns with NodeType "V2ray", or ERR
#   shell  protocol node_panel_parse_server prints, or - when it must refuse
#          (it also refuses ports the controller / inbounds would reject at startup)
#   port   expected port (- for ERR rows)
#   host   expected host= value (- when empty)
